title: NFL Quarterback Club '96
native_title: ＮＦＬ クォーターバック・クラブ’９６
overview:
A super-realistic football game!

Featuring the latest '96 data!

Over 800 formations in total!

Take the field in officially licensed NFL football, built around the league's top quarterbacks. Pick your team, call your plays from the formation screens and lead your offense down the field, with full player stats and substitutions along the way.

- Star quarterbacks including Kelly, Favre, Elway, Aikman, Bledsoe, Cunningham, Miller, Hostetler, Young and Marino
- The new Panthers and Jaguars teams are included
- 45 camera views cover every play
- Up to 12 players with the multi-terminal 6 adapter
- Memory backup support

超リアルなフットボールゲーム！

'96年最新データ搭載！

フォーメーション総数800以上！
